# Hazem Sallouha

Hazem Sallouha is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering (ESAT), KU Leuven, Belgium, in the WaveCore division.
His research covers signal processing in dense non-terrestrial wireless networks, joint communication, sensing and localization, and sustainable Internet of Things.

- Home and biography: https://hazem-ms.github.io/#bio
- Research: https://hazem-ms.github.io/research/
- Selected publications: https://hazem-ms.github.io/research/#publications
- Teaching: https://hazem-ms.github.io/teaching/
- Team: https://hazem-ms.github.io/team/
- Contact: https://hazem-ms.github.io/contact/
